risk_note: RV2 by path (orders read only). D10-850 ② (contract CT-24zx #2668): the user order list (GET /v1/orders) and detail (GET /v1/orders/{order_id}) fill reason_sub from orders.reason_sub. The key is left out when the value is null, or when the order's reason is not PUNISH / REFUND / RIGHTS (incl. null); a stored value that is not a sub of the current reason or not in enum order_reason_sub is left out too and warned once (alert order_reason_sub_invalid, reason, reason_sub; no order number, user or amount). Only items actually returned warn; the agent order card and search probe do not output reason_sub. No write, no change to reason / reason_action / display_status / amounts. The logger stays optional: OrdersModule's production wiring (orders.module.ts, outside the task paths) does not pass it yet, so production leaves invalid values out without the warning (FU-ORDERS-QUERY-LOGGER).
